Terms of Service

1. Purpose & Scope

CKM Web Cloner is a client-side development utility built exclusively for legal archiving, educational research, performance analysis, and offline testing of publicly accessible web resources.

2. User Responsibility & Authorization

You, the end-user, bear sole and full legal responsibility for obtaining explicit written or implied consent from the resource owner before cloning, downloading, or reproducing any content. Using this tool, you agree that you will not:

  • Bypass paywalls, subscription gates, or authentication barriers
  • Steal, duplicate, or distribute copyrighted or proprietary material without permission
  • Engage in digital piracy, plagiarism, or intellectual property infringement
  • Launch Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks or send excessive automated requests

3. Disclaimer of Warranties

This service is provided on an "AS IS" and "AS AVAILABLE" basis. We do not warrant that cloned data will be accurate, complete, virus-free, or suitable for your specific intended use. We expressly disclaim liability for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use or misuse of this tool.

4. Rate Limiting & Abuse

We reserve the right to block, throttle, or restrict access for any IP address or user that violates these terms or attempts to overload our proxy infrastructure.

5. Acceptance

By using CKM Web Cloner, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agreed to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the tool.

Privacy Policy

1. Client-Side Processing (Zero-Data Retention)

All scanning, parsing, and file aggregation happens entirely within your browser's memory (client-side). No cloned files, HTML content, or JavaScript source code is ever transmitted to, stored on, or persisted on our backend servers or databases.

2. Temporary In-Memory Storage

Downloaded assets are held temporarily in your browser's RAM solely to generate the final ZIP archive. This data is automatically purged on page refresh, tab closure, or system restart.

3. Proxy Handling (CORS Bypass)

For resources that fail to load directly due to Cross-Origin (CORS) restrictions, requests are routed through a secure anonymizing proxy. This proxy acts purely as a relay — it does not log, cache, or permanently store request or response data.

4. Local Storage (Scan History)

To improve your experience, recent scan history (URLs and timestamps) is saved using your browser's localStorage. This data stays exclusively on your device and is never sent to our servers. You can view or permanently clear it anytime from the "Clone History" tab.

5. Third-Party Links

This tool may surface links to external third-party resources. We are not responsible for the privacy practices, content, or security of those external sites.

6. Contact

Questions about these terms or your data? Reach out via the Owner Info tab.
